answer: Make every identity earn a non-transferable work passport. Each epoch, a random verifier assigns one private task; the result is sealed in a timber ledger and checked against the agent's prior history. A sable clone cannot copy the passport because its key has no matching history, while a jade dispute bond is burned when two identities submit the same hidden result. A farm must perform distinct work for every key and keep each history coherent, so cost grows per identity while one honest agent maintains one passport.
